paragraphs: Abba the expositor. Sifrei, Ha'azinu, at ערכ״א; Vezot Habberakhah, at ערמ״ג: “In Abba the expositor’s name.” He is early. Yalkut there, section 955, and Psalms 37, section 730, read: “In Abba the expositor’s name they said, ‘I was young.’” Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta spoke in his name (there, at ערכ״ב). Rabbah, Tetze, beginning of section 42: “This is Abba the expositor’s approach.”
